title: EVALUATING EXPLAINABILITY IN MACHINE LEARNING PREDICTIONS THROUGH EXPLAINER-AGNOSTIC METRICS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes and evaluates six model-agnostic metrics designed to quantify the explainability of machine learning model predictions.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings are focused on the development and application of novel metrics for evaluating machine learning model explainability on classification (Adult dataset) and regression (US-Crime dataset) tasks.
